name: [☢️] Build a Bunker!
desc:
☢️ Welcome to Build A Bunker!

Nukes hit the world every 5 minutes. Get loot from the town and use it to upgrade your bunker. Can you survive until help arrives?

[ How To Play ]
🍎 Grab food, 🔫 weapons, and 🪵 supplies
☢️ Get inside the bunker before the nuke
⚔️ Fight enemies and protect your bunker
🏗️ Build and upgrade your bunker
💀 Can you survive?
